name: authenticate-app-users
job: Add app sign-in, session, and recovery through Platform Auth.

inScope: Sign-up, sign-in, session, OAuth/OIDC, passkeys, and recovery
Authorizing server decisions with the verified principal
Proving issue and revoke of a session
outOfScope: Operator Platform IAM and management tokens

tools: Platform Auth SDK or runtime API

failureSemantics: A login page without a verified server principal is incomplete; revoke must make reuse fail.

outcome.observable: A user can sign in on the current Platform Auth contract, a protected route accepts the session, and revoke rejects reuse.
